name: gmail
description: Search, read, label, draft and send email in the user's Gmail.
summary: Search, read, organize and send Gmail
instructions:
WARNING: the send tool is on by default, so I can send email as you as soon as you connect. A message in your inbox can carry a prompt injection, text written to get me to forward your mail somewhere.

Turn send off before connecting. You have to do this yourself, from my plugin settings page:
1. Open /settings/plugins and pick gmail.
2. Under Permissions, set "Agents can use" to "Selected tools".
3. Click "Select all", untick send, then click "Save permissions".
I'll write drafts instead and you send them yourself.

Setup:
1. In https://console.cloud.google.com create a project and enable the Gmail API.
2. Under Google Auth Platform, set up the consent screen as External, then on Audience click Publish app. Apps left in Testing get tokens that expire after 7 days, so you'd have to reconnect weekly.
3. Under Clients, create an OAuth client of type Desktop app and set client_id and client_secret from it.
4. Once send is off, ask me to connect Gmail and I'll send you a link. Google warns the app is unverified, click Advanced and continue. After you allow access the browser shows an error page on 127.0.0.1, that's expected: copy the full address and send it back.

client_id.description: OAuth client ID of a Desktop app client, from Google Auth Platform > Clients in the Google Cloud console.

refresh_token.description: Set by the auth_complete tool, no need to fill it in.
